analysis.statistic: 100 * (1 - sum(candidate per-request repeat means) / sum(comparator per-request repeat means))
analysis.clear_simpler_dominance: RANDOM64 or ONCE has strictly lower updater time than PROGRESS64 and PROGRESS64-versus-arm latency interval upper bound < 0
analysis.updater_time_scope: Measured logical standalone training-pass worker wall plus scoring/selection worker wall, including packet loads and setup; shared event-1 work charged to every applicable policy; initialization, restoration, preparation and export excluded; compute timers reported separately
analysis.control_intervals: Descriptive and unadjusted; intervals crossing zero do not establish the added scoring mechanism
